research.notes: The school closed on August 16, 2026 (closure notice on its website). No registry entry (EIN, state entity number, SAM UEI) or legal operator name was verified; Wikipedia shows ownership by Universal Health Services. profile.summary: Provo Canyon School was a private residential treatment school in Utah for children and teens with behavioral, emotional and psychiatric needs. It was owned by Universal Health Services from 2000. It stopped providing services in August 2026.
